Usage: manyhands-cli [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  repo       
  remote     
  key        
  host       
  document   
  folder     
  ticket     
  comment    
  index      
  poll       
  operation  
  id         
  request    
  path       
  item       
  conflict   
  context    

Options:
      --json             Write a JSON result.
      --non-interactive  Run without terminal prompts.
      --help             Show help.
      --version          Show the version.

Command catalog:
